text.tspan: MASS APPROVAL
@unhappychoice approves 63 PRs in 7 days. Merge button reportedly smoking.
BURST MODE
@unhappychoice drops 92 commits on a Friday. Weekend plans: cancelled.
FLEET UPDATE
@unhappychoice rolls rubocop 1.91.0 across 4 Ruby repos simultaneously.
PATCH CHAOS
@unhappychoice discovers tachyonfx 'patch' release hiding +75 line diff. Experts alarmed.
MERMAID DRAMA
@unhappychoice pins mermaid back to pre-12 defaults after diagrams go rogue.
POLYGLOT ALERT
@unhappychoice merges Rust, Ruby, JS, and Java deps in a single week. Unhinged.
LLM PRICES
@unhappychoice automates LiteLLM pricing sync. Token costs now updated daily.
VITEST 5 LANDS
@unhappychoice manually upgrades vitest to v5. One small step for deps, one giant leap.
